evidence_spans: The VOC and JSC were measured to be 0.47 V and 28.2 mA cm⁻², respectively.
pristine Gr/n-Si Schottky junction solar cell
under simulated solar illumination (AM 1.5G, 100 mW cm⁻²)

Photovoltaic performance was evaluated by measuring current density–voltage (J–V) characteristics under simulated solar illumination (AM 1.5G, 100 mW cm⁻²) and in the dark, using a Keithley 2400 source measurement unit.
CLM-DEV-0067.statement: The open-circuit voltage of the pristine Gr/n-Si solar cell under illumination is 0.47 V.

evidence_spans: We find that the spin-coated PEDOT:PSS layer has a thickness of approximately 100 nm, which has been considered as a proper thickness for antireflection [22].
cross-sectional images were acquired via scanning electron microscopy (SEM) using a JSM-7000F instrument (JEOL Ltd.).
CLM-DEV-0068.statement: The spin-coated PEDOT:PSS layer thickness is approximately 100 nm.
